description: Get tasks from a specific Microsoft Todo list. These are the main todo items that can contain checklist items (subtasks).

count.description: Whether to include a count of tasks

select.description: Comma-separated subset of the shown fields to include: status, dueDateTime, importance, categories, recurrence, body (e.g., 'status,dueDateTime'). id and title are always included; other names are ignored.

top.description: Maximum number of tasks to retrieve

name: get-tasks
